messages:
laura-sre: Heads up — incoming assessment intake for ACME (external) starts Mon 03/18. They requested RBAC and KMS access to staging for a 6hr window. Can we confirm ops gate + evidence handoff?
adam-eng: Thanks — scope looks like: auth service (RBAC), kms proxy, audit-stream. Any embargoed endpoints?
chiara-sec: No embargo besides read-only access to keys metadata. They do *not* get plaintext key material. We need ephemeral roles + CloudTrail/AL logs included.
laura-sre: @olivia-ops can you allocate an ephemeral role window and create presigned upload for evidence? Prefer S3 prefix: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme/20240318/
olivia-ops: I can. Will provision a role with duration 6 hours and S3 put-only policy. I'll post ARN + presign TTL momentarily.
devsec-bot: [automated] Created ticket SEC-4123: "ACME external assessment intake" assigned to #eng-security, due 2024-03-18.
chiara-sec: We need clarity on KMS proxy — does assessment require Encrypt/Decrypt or just GenerateDataKey? If only metadata, we can grant kms:DescribeKey + kms:GenerateDataKey with encryption disabled.
adam-eng: They want to exercise wrap/unwrap paths too — so GenerateDataKey and Decrypt needed for the proxy path. We'll keep keys in staging KMS (alias staging/pt).
laura-sre: Ok — provisional plan: ephemeral role with kms:DescribeKey, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt; S3 put-only presigned upload; cloudtrail + audit-stream capture for the window. Also we need RBAC test accounts mapped to a feature-flagged sandbox org.
chiara-sec: Important: do NOT grant broad iam:PassRole. Use a scoped role with explicit sts:AssumeRole and a deny for iam:PassRole. Also enable key policy condition restricting to the ephemeral role's principal.
olivia-ops: Draft role policy (short):
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:DescribeKey", "kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-pt-staging"},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:PutObject"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/acme/20240318/*"}
  ]
}
```
will post ARN in 5.
adam-eng: For audit logging, we'll add a prefix filter for the audit exporter so we can tie events to SEC-4123. Also adding a logging pipeline tag: pt=acme-sec4123.
laura-sre: Can we do a dry-run on Thurs 03/14 for 30m to validate presign + role + audit export? I want a quick end-to-end before the real window.
chiara-sec: +1. I'll run a mini-scope: try GenerateDataKey + Decrypt; verify CloudTrail events show kms:Decrypt for the ephemeral role.
olivia-ops: Dry-run scheduled Thu 03/14 1600-1630 PT. I'll post the presign and role ARN after this message.
olivia-ops: role ARN: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/pt-acme-ephemeral-20240314 ; presign URL expires in 1 hour (will regenerate for main window).
laura-sre: Thanks. I'll add steps to SEC-4123 checklist: 1) dry-run pass, 2) evidence prefix validated, 3) RBAC test accounts provisioned, 4) retest window scheduled.
adam-eng: Question: do we want an automatic rollback (deny) after 6h? Recommend automation to revoke the role and rotate the staging key alias to a locked policy.
chiara-sec: Agree — add a Lambda to set a Deny policy on the role's trust document at T+6h and move alias staging/pt -> staging/pt-locked if issues.
laura-sre: I'll capture that as remediation-hooks in the ticket. Also set calendar invite for the retest slot (tentative) Wed 03/27 09:00-11:00 PT. Can folks confirm?
adam-eng: Confirmed. I'll be on call and watching audit stream.
chiara-sec: Confirmed. I'll own evidence verification during the retest.
olivia-ops: Confirmed. I'll hand off presign + role snapshot to assessors in the calendar invite and paste instructions for presigned upload.
laura-sre: Great — dry-run reminder Thu and final checklist in SEC-4123. Ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
